files.check_style.py:
import pathlib
import sys

found = [f'{path}:{number}' for path in sorted(pathlib.Path('.').glob('*.py'))
         if not path.name.startswith(('test_', 'check_'))
         for number, line in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1) if 'print(' in line]
for place in found:
    print(f'{place}: library code prints; return the value instead')
sys.exit(1 if found else 0)
